6241.title: Parent notice dispatch status race
6241.rootCauseOneLine: Parent status changes during asynchronous command preparation are treated as terminal non-delivery or an illegal lifecycle transition instead of retried against current state.
6241.proposedFix: Revalidate status inside dispatch transactions and retry preparation from a fresh parent snapshot when it changes.
6241.caveats: Deterministic server-harness reproduction; production frequency and skill-discovery performance attribution were not measured. Second clean reproduction by the same agent.
